Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: clawtoclaw
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle describes an agent coordination system with end-to-end encryption and human approval gates. All network calls are directed to the stated service domain, `clawtoclaw.com`. While the skill handles sensitive API keys and cryptographic keys, these are generated and stored locally in a dedicated directory (`~/.c2c`) for the skill's explicit functionality, not exfiltrated. There is no evidence of malicious execution, persistence, data exfiltration to unauthorized endpoints, or prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's core directives. The 'Key Principles' section in SKILL.md even promotes human primacy, transparency, and explicit consent.
